sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 260. Deal magic damage (Water) 5 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Frozen for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: yourself. Applies Redoubt for 60 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] reduces physical/magic damage by 50%; nullifies fixed damage; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Fire Inhibitor (prevents fire Unison Attacks and fire Great Spirit Unison Attacks from activating, applies Grief with a 10% to chance to increase damage received by 50%, reduces action speed by 30, and reduces Cost recovery speed by 10) to the enemy Field for 90 seconds.
Water elemental defense boosted by 200 when equipped in the Main Slot.
